links.subject: tevaram.ifp.2.85

links.subject: tirumurai8.tiruvacakam.s02
links.display_note: Section 2 explicitly names Uttarakosamangai in the poem while the source header says it was composed at Tillai. This is a textual sthalam reference, not an Uttarakosamangai composition claim.

links.subject: tirumurai8.tiruvacakam.s06

links.subject: tirumurai8.tiruvacakam.s16
